repairs.question_title: What boundary could help protect my everyday balance?
repairs.problem_sentence: When a new request arrives, name the work already using your time and ask which responsibility should move before you agree.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 5개 프로필에 같은 일반 조언이 반복됐고, 개인의 업무 역할과 사생활에서 필요한 점이 답에 드러나지 않았습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Build the boundary from the profile's calculated work-role wording and private-life need. Do not reuse the generic balance-week action.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: A useful boundary is to protect [profile-specific need] by deciding which work request can wait. Your chart centres on [profile-specific work pattern]; repeated requests can compete with that focus and your personal time.

repairs.question_title: How do my personality, career, money and love connect?
repairs.problem_sentence: The former lead linked work, money and relationships but omitted the personality theme.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 질문에 적힌 네 영역 중 성격이 실제 결론에서 빠져 있었습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Name the personal style, career theme, chart-supported earning route, and separate close-relationship need in the direct answer.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: Your personal style centres on [profile-specific focus]. At work, your chart points to [work theme]; [income route]. These areas meet through the time and effort you can give, while your close relationships have a separate need: [private need]. The chart describes connected themes, not a guaranteed cause or outcome.

repairs.question_title: Which years are most important for me?
repairs.problem_sentence: The lead said no specific year could be named even when a checked timing comparison appeared in its detail.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 연도 정규식이 연주 표기 (간지)를 포함한 제목을 읽지 못해, 답변 첫 문장과 실제 근거가 서로 모순됐습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Read the year and concise theme from verified turning-point comparisons. State no year only when those comparisons contain none.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: The chart flags 2026 (recognised responsibility and clear standards); 2031 (independent judgement); 2032 (ideas, expression and improving a method) as review years. These comparisons identify themes, not guaranteed life events.

repairs.question_title: What should I prioritise over the next three years?
repairs.problem_sentence: The former answer used a stock six-month check and did not derive its priority from the selected chart theme.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 실제 개인별 연간 업무 주제가 답에 연결되지 않았습니다. 또한 계산하지 않은 3개년 예측은 만들면 안 됩니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Derive one useful focus from the current annual chart chapter; disclose that this is a priority, not a year-by-year forecast.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: For the next three years, prioritise [profile-specific annual work theme]. The annual chart comparison identifies this as a useful focus; it does not provide a separate forecast for each of the three years.
